annotations.title: Questions buyers ask AI about a business type

description: Builds the questions a customer is likely to ask an AI assistant (in Hebrew) before choosing a business of a given type, grouped by stage of the buying journey: the problem, comparing options, choosing a provider, price, trust and after the purchase. Use when a business owner wants to know what customers ask ChatGPT or Claude about their field, city or services.

kind.description: Type of business, in Hebrew if possible, e.g. "מרפאת שיניים" or "עורך דין לדיני עבודה"
